assumptions.text: C10C is treated as a common low-carbon steel with no heat treatment required, per the feature graph part-level material and heat-treatment fields.
Tolerance capability values in the shop profile are interpreted as suitable for assessing the listed bilateral dimensional and GD&T requirements at a feasibility level.

Missing internal depths and ambiguous Detail-B callout attachments are treated as clarification risks rather than hard feasibility blockers because the extracted diameters and accessible coaxial geometry are within available machine capability.

reasoning_summary: The part is a very small axisymmetric C10C steel plunger with moderate OD, bore, runout, taper, chamfer, and radius requirements that fit the shop envelope and are generally within the listed CNC turning/SPM/tool-room/inspection capabilities. Feasibility is not blocked, but it should proceed only with risks because the drawing calls the part cold formed, several stepped internal depths and Detail-B interpretations are unclear, and the 10 SCCM leakage-test capability is not explicitly confirmed in the shop profile.
